LSD/HSD Post-Hoc Calculator

lsd_hsd_calculator.Rd

Calculates LSD and HSD minimum mean differences using a studentized range table.

Usage

lsd_hsd_calculator(k, n_per_group, mse, df_error_input)

Arguments

k

Integer. Number of groups (3-6).

n_per_group

Numeric. Average n per group.

mse

Numeric. Mean square error from the ANOVA.

df_error_input

Numeric. Error degrees of freedom.

Value

A list with lsd, hsd, and parameters_used.

Examples

lsd_hsd_calculator(k = 4, n_per_group = 25, mse = 10.5, df_error_input = 96)
#> $lsd
#> [1] 1.842195
#> 
#> $hsd
#> [1] 1.700136
#> 
#> $parameters_used
#> $parameters_used$closest_df
#> [1] 90
#> 
#> $parameters_used$q_value
#> [1] 3.71
#> 
#> $parameters_used$t_crit
#> [1] 2.01
#> 
#>
